column1: # Decision-brief SessionStart hook commands every sdf on this branch has written.
# Format: tool<TAB>command. The Claude form includes the GROK_HOOK_EVENT guard;
# detection strips that guard before comparing, so both rows of a pair share one body.
# Current pair first, then earlier unreleased forms so re-init upgrades them in place.

column2: [ -z "${GROK_HOOK_EVENT:-}" ] || exit 0; command -v sdf >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; sdf_out=$(sdf decision brief </dev/null 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; [ -n "$sdf_out" ] && printf '%s\n' "$sdf_out"; exit 0
command -v sdf >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; sdf_out=$(sdf decision brief </dev/null 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; [ -n "$sdf_out" ] && printf '%s\n' "$sdf_out"; exit 0
[ -z "${GROK_HOOK_EVENT:-}" ] || exit 0; command -v sdf >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; exec sdf decision brief 2>/dev/null
command -v sdf >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; exec sdf decision brief 2>/dev/null
